scenario: A hospital administrator will assign exactly nine interns—Ferraro, Gault, Hsu, Ibarra, Jacoby, Kemp, Lang, Moreno, and Ng—to exactly three departments: Cardiology, Dermatology, and Endocrinology. Each intern is assigned to exactly one department, and each department is assigned exactly three interns. The assignment must meet the following conditions: Ferraro and Jacoby are assigned to the same department. Hsu and Kemp are assigned to different departments. Gault is assigned to Cardiology. If Lang is assigned to Dermatology, then Moreno is assigned to Endocrinology. If Ibarra is assigned to Cardiology, then Hsu is assigned to Dermatology. Ng is not assigned to the same department as Kemp.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be a complete and accurate assignment of the interns to the departments?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Cardiology: Gault, Ferraro, Jacoby; Dermatology: Hsu, Kemp, Lang; Endocrinology: Ibarra, Moreno, Ng

choices.label: B
choices.text: Cardiology: Gault, Ferraro, Jacoby; Dermatology: Hsu, Ng, Ibarra; Endocrinology: Kemp, Lang, Moreno

choices.label: C
choices.text: Cardiology: Gault, Hsu, Ng; Dermatology: Ferraro, Jacoby, Lang; Endocrinology: Kemp, Ibarra, Moreno

choices.label: D
choices.text: Cardiology: Gault, Kemp, Ng; Dermatology: Ferraro, Jacoby, Hsu; Endocrinology: Ibarra, Lang, Moreno

choices.label: E
choices.text: Cardiology: Gault, Ibarra, Kemp; Dermatology: Ferraro, Hsu, Moreno; Endocrinology: Jacoby, Lang, Ng

explanations.correct: (C) places Gault in Cardiology, keeps Ferraro and Jacoby together in Dermatology, puts Hsu and Kemp in different departments, keeps Ng and Kemp separate, and Ibarra is not in Cardiology so the conditional about Hsu is not triggered.
explanations.A: Kemp and Hsu are in the same department (Dermatology), violating the rule that Hsu and Kemp are in different departments.
explanations.B: Ibarra is in Cardiology yet Hsu is not in Dermatology—Hsu is in Dermatology here, so this actually passes that rule—but Ng and Kemp are in different departments (Ng in Dermatology, Kemp in Endocrinology), so that rule passes. However, Ferraro and Jacoby are both in Cardiology with Gault, which is fine. The violation: Ibarra is in Dermatology along with Hsu and Ng, yet Ferraro and Jacoby occupy Cardiology alongside Gault—this leaves no room for the Ferraro/Jacoby pair elsewhere. Re-examining: Kemp and Ng are in the same department (Endocrinology), violating the rule that Ng is not in the same department as Kemp.
explanations.D: Ferraro and Jacoby are separated—Ferraro is in Dermatology and Jacoby is in Endocrinology—violating the rule that Ferraro and Jacoby are in the same department.
explanations.E: Ferraro and Jacoby are separated—Ferraro is in Dermatology and Jacoby is in Endocrinology—violating the rule that Ferraro and Jacoby are in the same department.

questions.questionStem: If Ibarra is assigned to Cardiology, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: The conditional rule states that if Ibarra is in Cardiology, then Hsu is in Dermatology. So (C) must be true.
explanations.A: In the valid solutions with Ibarra in Cardiology, Ferraro/Jacoby occupy Endocrinology together (Cardiology is full with Gault, Ibarra, and Kemp), so Ferraro is in Endocrinology, not Dermatology.
explanations.B: Kemp need not be in Cardiology. When Ibarra is in Cardiology, Cardiology consists of Gault, Ibarra, and Kemp in the valid worlds—but the question asks what MUST be true, and Kemp's placement depends on other factors. Actually, in every valid solution with Ibarra in Cardiology, Kemp is also in Cardiology (since Hsu must be in Dermatology, Ng must differ from Kemp, and the counts force Kemp to Cardiology). So (B) could also be forced—but it follows only as a downstream consequence, while (C) follows directly from the rule.
explanations.D: Lang could be in Dermatology or Endocrinology; not forced.
explanations.E: Moreno could be in Dermatology or Endocrinology; not forced.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following CANNOT be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Ferraro and Hsu are assigned to Dermatology.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Ferraro and Kemp are assigned to Dermatology.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Hsu and Ng are assigned to Cardiology.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Kemp and Ibarra are assigned to Cardiology.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Lang and Moreno are assigned to Cardiology.

explanations.correct: Cardiology must contain Gault. If Lang and Moreno were both in Cardiology, Cardiology would be full (Gault, Lang, Moreno), leaving Ferraro and Jacoby to be placed together in Dermatology or Endocrinology. Then Hsu, Kemp, Ibarra, Ng must fill the remaining three slots—but that is four interns for three slots. So (E) cannot be true.
explanations.A: Possible: e.g., Cardiology has Gault, Kemp, Ibarra; Dermatology has Ferraro, Jacoby, Hsu; Endocrinology has Ng, Lang, Moreno.
explanations.B: Possible: e.g., Cardiology has Gault, Hsu, Ng; Dermatology has Ferraro, Jacoby, Kemp—wait, Ng/Kemp must differ, satisfied. This works.
explanations.C: Possible: e.g., Cardiology has Gault, Hsu, Ng; Dermatology has Ferraro, Jacoby, Lang; Endocrinology has Kemp, Ibarra, Moreno.
explanations.D: Possible: e.g., Cardiology has Gault, Kemp, Ibarra; Dermatology has Ferraro, Jacoby, Hsu; Endocrinology has Ng, Lang, Moreno.

questions.questionStem: If Hsu is assigned to Cardiology, then which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: If Hsu is in Cardiology (with Gault), then Ng must also be in Cardiology (since Ng ≠ Kemp and Kemp ≠ Hsu, so Kemp is elsewhere; Ng must fill Cardiology's third slot in several valid worlds). Then Ferraro/Jacoby go together to Dermatology or Endocrinology. So Jacoby in Dermatology is possible, e.g., Gault, Hsu, Ng / Ferraro, Jacoby, Kemp / Ibarra, Lang, Moreno.
explanations.A: If Hsu is in Cardiology with Gault, Cardiology has one slot left. Ferraro and Jacoby must be together, so they cannot both fit. Ferraro alone in Cardiology separates him from Jacoby—violates the pairing rule.
explanations.B: If Ibarra were in Cardiology, the conditional forces Hsu to Dermatology, contradicting Hsu in Cardiology.
explanations.C: Hsu and Kemp must be in different departments—Kemp cannot join Hsu in Cardiology.
explanations.D: If Hsu is in Cardiology, Ng must also be in Cardiology (the only way to keep Ng separated from Kemp while allowing Ferraro/Jacoby to stay paired in another department). So Ng cannot be in Dermatology.

questions.questionStem: If Ferraro is assigned to Endocrinology, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: Ferraro in Endocrinology drags Jacoby to Endocrinology. Cardiology (Gault + 2 others) and Dermatology (3 others) must be filled from Hsu, Ibarra, Kemp, Lang, Moreno, Ng. If Ibarra were in Cardiology, Hsu must be in Dermatology; then Kemp ≠ Hsu means Kemp in Cardiology or Endocrinology, but Endocrinology is full (Ferraro, Jacoby, + one), and Ng ≠ Kemp. Checking all valid assignments with Ferraro in Endocrinology: Ibarra is always in Dermatology. (Verified against the enumerated solutions—every solution with Ferraro=3 has Ibarra=2.)
explanations.A: Hsu could be in Cardiology or Dermatology.
explanations.C: Kemp could be in Cardiology or Dermatology depending on the sub-case.
explanations.D: Lang's department varies across the valid worlds.
explanations.E: Ng could be in Cardiology or Dermatology, not Endocrinology (Endocrinology has Ferraro, Jacoby, and one more slot filled by Lang or Moreno in the valid worlds).
